searchTerms.title: Search terms (optional)
searchTerms.description: Leave empty to use the built-in GTA 6 / trailer / leak / gameplay / map set.

form.title: Video form
form.description: Limit results to YouTube Shorts, longer videos, or both.

maxVideos.title: Max videos in total
maxVideos.description: Hard cap on videos returned (and charged) in this run.

maxVideosPerTerm.title: Max videos per search term
maxVideosPerTerm.description: Maximum videos collected from each search term before the total cap.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many video-detail fetches to run in parallel (1–8).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: YouTube often blocks cloud IPs (LOGIN_REQUIRED). Leave the default Apify datacenter proxy on for platform runs. Do not enable residential groups unless a run is still blocked.
